description: Phase 3B. Exercises the multi-channel rendezvous taxonomy end-to-end: the engine's experimental-families gate is enabled on day 1; the rendezvous priority is overridden on day 2 to put `sqs` ahead of the default `domain_fronted_broker`; the gate is then briefly disabled on day 12 and re-enabled on day 13 to assert that the rendezvous override survives session-relevant toggles. The legacy 1.5C-class subscription-url block is layered on so the soak invariant ledger continues to assert the distribution-failure gates. Per-route + per-network winning-channel persistence is the principal regression: the engine MUST persist the channel that wins its first Solicit, and on day 22 (after a network roam at day 20) the netmem hint MUST bias the next Selector race to the winner from the prior network.
